questions.question: If 9685 is divided into three parts in such a way that one-fourth of the first part, one-third of the second part and one-sixth of the third part are equal, then what is the first part?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number = 9685

(1/4) first part = (1/3) second part = (1/6) third part

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**The first number is divisible by 4 according to the question.

The option which is divisible by 4 will be the answer.

From the given options, we can see, only 2980 among

the options are divisible by 4.

∴ First part of the number is 2980. 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] 

__Alternate Method__**

Let first part, second part, and third part be a, b and c respectively.

⇒ a/4 = b/3 = c/6 = k

⇒ a = 4k, b = 3k and c = 6k

⇒ a + b + c = 9685

⇒ 4k + 3k + 6k = 9685

⇒ k = 745

First part = a = 745 × 4 = 2980

**∴ The first part of the number is 2980. **

questions.question: If x + y = 5 and x² + y² = 17 then the value of 〖(x-y)〗² is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

⇒ x + y = 5 

⇒ x2 + y2 = 17

**Formula:**

⇒ (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

⇒ (a - b)2 = a2 + b2 - 2ab

**Calculation:**

⇒ (x + y)² = x² + y² + 2xy

⇒ 2xy = 25 - 17 = 8

Then,

(x - y)² = x² + y² - 2xy 

= 17 - 8 

= 9

**∴ (x - y)2 = 9**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Put x = 4 and y = 1, it satisfies the condition given in the question.

(x - y)2 = (4 - 1)²

⇒ 9

∴ (x - y)2 = 9

questions.question: The sides AB and AC of a ∆ABC are produced up to points D and E. The bisectors of the exterior angles to formed. intersect each other at point I if ∠ACB is 66⁰ and ∠ABC is 440, then what is the measure (in degrees) of ∠BIC?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠ACB = 66º and ∠ABC = 44º

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9d0e1b38ae693e3fcf54198155669cc9d9db0d46d88f4a979107d679d93140f.png] 

∠ABC + ∠CBD = 180 ....(Linear angles)

∠CBD = 180º - 44º = 136º

Using angle bisector,

∠CBI = ∠IBD = 136º/2 = 68º

∠ACB + ∠BCE = 180º ....(Linear angles)

∠BCE = 180º - 66º = 114º

Using angle bisector,

∠BCI = ∠ICE = 114º/2

∠BCI = 57º

In ΔBCI,

∠BCI + ∠CBI + ∠BIC = 180º

∠BIC = 180º - 68º - 57º = 55º

**∴ ∠BIC = 55º**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**∠A = 180° - (44° + 66°)

⇒ ∠A = 70° 

∠BIC = 90 - ∠A/2 (Exterior angle bisector)

∠BIC = 90 - 70/2

⇒ 90 - 35 = 55° 

∴ ∠BIC = 55º

questions.question: When an integer n is divided by 6, the remainder is 5. What is the remainder if 9n is divided by 6?
questions.solution:
**Given**:

When an integer n is divided by 6, the remainder is 5

**Formula:**

Number = quotient × Divisor + remainder

**Calculation:**

n = quotient × 6 + 5

9n = 9(6 × quotient + 5) 

= 9 × 6 × quotient + 5 × 9

= 9 × 6 × quotient + 7 × 6 + 3

= 6(9quotient + 7) + 3

**∴ 3 is the remainder if 9n is divided by 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Let the integer be (6 + 5) = 11

Now, 9n = 9 × 11 = 99

When we divide 99 by 6 we get 16 as quotient and 3 as remainder.

∴ 3 is the remainder if 9n is divided by 6.

questions.question: If the simple interest for 9 years be equal to 45% of the principal, then the rate of interest per annum is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

SI for 9 years = 45% of P

**Formula:**

Let P = Principal, R = rate of interest and N = time period

SI = PNR/100

**Calculation:**

⇒ SI = P × R × 9/100

⇒ 9PR/100 = 45P/100

⇒ R = 5

**∴ Rate of interest is 5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Topper's approach -

45% amount increases in 9 years.

5% amount increases in 1 year.

∴ Rate of interest is 5%.

questions.question:
Solve for x?

sin²x - 4 sin x + 3 = 0, 0 ≤ x ≤ π/2
questions.solution:
**Given:**

sin²x - 4 sin x + 3 = 0

**Calculation:**

Let sinx = k

⇒ k² - 4k + 3 = 0

⇒ k² - 3k - k + 3 = 0

⇒ k(k - 3) - 1(k - 3) = 0

⇒ (k - 1)(k - 3) = 0

k = 1 or k = 3

Then,

⇒ sin x = 1

⇒ x = sin ⁻¹(1)

**∴ x = π/2**

questions.question: Two person P and Q are 844 m apart. The both start cycling simultaneously in the same direction with speeds of 12 m/s and 8 m/s, respectively, In how much time will P overtake Q?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance = 844m

Speed of cyclists = 12m/s and 8m/s

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed = Speed of faster cyclist - speed of slower cyclist

**Calculation:**

Relative speed of two cyclists = 12 - 8 = 4 m/s

⇒ Time after which they will overtake = 844/4

⇒ 211 sec

⇒ 3 min and 31 sec

**∴ The time taken by P to overtake Q is 3 min 31 sec.**

questions.question: The average monthly expenditure of a man is Rs.2400 during the first three month, Rs 3,500 during the next five months and Rs 4,800 for the remaining four months. If his total saving is Rs.3,500 during the entire year. then what is his average monthly income (in Rs)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average expenditure for first three months = Rs.2400

Average expenditure for five months = Rs.3500

Average expenditure for four months = Rs.4800

**Formula:**

Average = (Sum of terms)/Number of terms

**Calculation:**

Total expenditure for first three months = 2400 × 3 = Rs.7200

Total expenditure for five months = 3500 × 5 = Rs.17500

Total expenditure for four months = 4800 × 4 = Rs.19200

Total expenditure in a year = 7200 + 17500 + 19200 = Rs.43900

Total income in a year = 439000 + 3500 = Rs.47400

**∴ Average monthly income = 47400/12 = Rs.3950**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**To ease the calculation, let the average expenditure per month be Rs. 3500.

Deflection in the expenditure for first 3 months

⇒ (2400 - 3500) × 3 = -3300

Deflection in the expenditure for the next 5 months be zero.

Deflection in the expenditure for the last four months.

⇒ (4800 - 3500) × 4 = 5200

The total deflection = 5200 - 3300 = 1900

Correct expenditure for 12 months = 3500 × 12 + 1900

Total income for 12 months = 42000 + 1900 + 3500(savings)

⇒ 47400

The average salary = 47400/12 = Rs. 3950

questions.question: By selling an article for Rs 8,670 a man loses 15% At what price (in Rs) should he sell it in order to make a profit of 15%?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

SP = Rs.8670

Loss% = 15%

**Formula:**

Profit % = (SP - CP)/CP × 100

Loss % = (CP - SP)/CP × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ 15 = (CP - 8670)/CP × 100

⇒ CP = Rs.10200

Then,

⇒ 15 = (SP - 10200)/10200 × 100

 ⇒ SP = 11730

**∴ Selling price is Rs.11730 when profit % is 15%.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**(100 - 15)% = 8670

⇒ 85% = 8670

⇒ 1% = 8670/85

SP on 15% profit = 115 × (8670/85)

⇒ Rs. 11730

∴ Selling price is Rs.11730 when profit % is 15%.

questions.question: A number is mistakenly multiplied by 7/5 instead of being multipiled by 3/2, what is the percentage change in the result due to this mistake?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let number be N.

⇒ N × 7/5 = 7N/5

⇒ N × 3/2 = 3N/2

**∴ % change in result = (3N/2 - 7N/5)/3N/2 × 100 = 6.6667% = 6(2)/(3)\% **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Let the no. be = 10

Incorrect value = 10 × 7/5 = 14

Correct value = 10 × 3/2 = 15

Ratio of correct to incorrect = 15 : 14

% change = 1/15 = 6(2)/(3)\%

questions.question: A can complete a piece of work in 7 days and B can complete the same work in 12 days. A and B worked together for 3 days. C alone completed the remaining work in 9 days will C take to complete the same work entirely?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A's 1 day's work = 1/7

B's 1 day's work = 1/12

**Calculation:**

(A + B)'s 1 day's work = 1/7 + 1/12 = 19/84

(A + B)'s 3 days work = 3 × 19/84 = 19/28

Remaining work = 1 - 19/28 = 9/28

Number of days in which C alone can complete work = 28/9 × 9 = 28 days

**∴ C alone can complete work in 28 days. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Let the total work be 84.(LCM of 7 and 12)

Efficiency of A = 84/7 = 12

Efficiency of B = 84/12 = 7

The work of A + B in 3 days = 19 × 3 = 57

Remaining work = 84 - 57 = 27

Efficiency of C = 27/9 = 3

Time required for C = 84/3 = 28 days

questions.question: The sum of the radii of two circles is 286 cm and the area between the concentric circle is 50336 cm² what are the radii (in cm) of the two circles? Take pi =frac{{22}}{7}
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sum of radii = 286cm

Area of concentric circles = 50336 cm²

**Formula:**

Area of circle = πr²

**Calculation:**

Let area of bigger circle and smaller circle be R cm and r cm respectively.

⇒ πR² - πr² = 50336

⇒ R² - r² = 16016

⇒ (R - r)(R + r) = 16016

⇒ (R - r) = 56

 (R + r) = 286

Solving,

R = 171 cm and r = 115cm

**∴ Radius of smaller circle and bigger circle is 115cm and 171cm respectively.**

questions.question: What is the length (in cm) of the longest rod that can be fitted in a box dimensions 28 cm × 4 cm × 10 cm ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Dimensions of box = 28 × 4 × 10

**Formula:**

Diagonal of cuboid = √(l² + b² + h²)

**Calculation:**

Diagonal of given cuboid box = √(28² + 4² + 10²) = √(784 + 16 + 100) = √(800 + 100) = √(900) = 30cm

**∴ the length of the longest rod that can be fitted in a box dimensions 28 cm × 4 cm × 10 cm is 30cm.**
